想去海边，又不想只拍一张照片就走？今年可以约朋友一起参加 Coastal Cle: For a seaside visit with a purpose, friends could join Coastal Cleanup Day, collect small pieces of litter, learn about common waste and wash up before lunch. Choosing one site was enough; there was no need to cross the whole Bay Area.

2026 年加州 Coastal Cleanup Day 的统一日期是 9 月: California's Coastal Cleanup Day 2026 was September 19, a Saturday, with the main statewide period from 9am to noon. Sites could have different times or dates. Each site's registration and meeting notice governed the actual arrangements.
这是志愿活动，不是免费景区通票: Volunteering does not provide free admission elsewhere

官方列 9 月 19 日 9:00–12:00，集合点为 Stairwell 1: The official listing gave September 19, 9am–noon, meeting at Stairwell 17. Advance registration and the correct site selection were required; groups of five or more needed arrangements. The photo shows the northern coast; the registration email determined the meeting point.
这里是 10:00–12:00，从 Treasure Island Museum: The listing gave 10am–noon, meeting at Treasure Island Museum to clean around Cityside Park and Clipper Cove. Participation was free with advance registration. The source noted wheelchair access and suggested Muni 25, ferries or carpooling. Participants needing level routes should confirm the work area and assistance.

Save The Bay 日历已列 9 月 19 日 9:00–12:00 的: Save The Bay's calendar listed an Oakland event on September 19, 9am–noon, with registration from the event page. Its rules required a parent or guardian to sign in participants under 18 and accompany those under 13 throughout. Other organizations' sites had separate rules.
保存报名确认、具体集合点和负责人联络方式；地图上同一片海滩可能有多个入口。: Save registration confirmation, the exact meeting point and organizer contact; a beach may have several entrances.
按报名要求完成免责表，带孩子时先确认签字与陪同要求；不要默认孩子能单独留下。: Complete required waivers and confirm signatures and supervision for children; do not assume they can be left alone.
有条件就带可重复使用的桶、手套和水瓶；穿包脚鞋，准备防晒与防风外层。: Bring reusable buckets, gloves and water if available; wear closed-toe shoes and prepare sun and wind protection.
先听现场安全讲解，在指定区域行动；针头、化学品或不明危险物品留给工作人员处理。: Listen to the safety briefing and stay in designated areas. Leave needles, chemicals and unknown hazards to staff.
给回程留一套干净用品和洗手时间；是否需要服务时数证明，报名时就问清楚。: Plan time and supplies for washing up afterward. Ask about volunteer-hour records when registering.
编辑建议只约一个共同目标：完成主办方安排的时段。带孩子可以让他们观察收集到哪类垃: The editorial suggestion was one shared goal: attend the organizer's session. Children could observe common litter and share a discovery. Obtain consent before photographing people, then choose lunch or home according to energy levels. If registration was full, check official alternatives rather than joining an unconfirmed work crew.
East Bay Regional Park District 提供多处站点，通: East Bay Regional Park District listed multiple sites, generally recommending registration; groups of ten or more needed arrangements. Choose a suitable site and save its specific instructions.
